hypotheses.P0_pair_synergy_router_validates: A router using only singleton and exact pair-synergy response features reaches median fidelity >=0.95 and 10th percentile >=0.80 on grouped FineWeb CV and frozen WikiText.
hypotheses.P1_pair_synergy_adds_value: It improves 10th-percentile fidelity by at least 0.10 over the best invariant singleton fingerprint on both corpora.
hypotheses.P2_pair_synergy_features_are_used: Shuffling WikiText pair-synergy fingerprints across sites reduces 10th-percentile fidelity by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.P3_second_order_path_grammar_is_insuffic: The router remains below 0.80 at the 10th percentile on either corpus.
